models.name: JEV-35B
models.size: NVFP4 25.6GB (~23GiB weights); fits a single 32-48GB GPU
models.verdict: The closest match to a classification-criteria-optimized LLM: 256 options scored per pass at interactive latency.
models.what: System 1 decision model: compares up to 256 text/image options in one forward pass and returns calibrated probabilities. Decision Index 0.3 public suite: 59.73 (beats JEV-27B-VL 53.64). Quantized NVFP4 keeps 96.6% of BF16 decisions.
models.what_ko: System 1 decision 모델: 한 번의 forward pass로 최대 256개 텍스트/이미지 옵션을 비교하고 보정된 확률(calibrated probabilities) 반환. Decision Index 0.3 공개 스위트: 59.73 (JEV-27B-VL 53.64 상회). NVFP4 양자화해도 BF16 결정의 96.6% 유지.
models.verdict_ko: 분류기준 최적화 LLM에 가장 근접: 패스당 256개 옵션 스코어링을 인터랙티브 지연으로.

models.name: Clef-Flash
models.verdict: A real decision model, but not a chat LLM and not useful on Mac/MLX — excluded from the main rankings.
models.what: Decision model: takes state (text/JSON/image/video) + typed question schema, returns per-option probabilities in a single prefill-only forward pass. No free-form text generation. Jev/SystemOne API-compatible. Decision Index: 5th place, 57.07 (self-reported).
models.what_ko: Decision 모델: 상태(텍스트/JSON/이미지/비디오) + typed question schema를 입력받아 단일 prefill-only forward pass로 옵션별 확률 반환. 자유 텍스트 생성 없음. Jev/SystemOne API 호환. Decision Index 5위, 57.07 (자체 발표).
models.verdict_ko: 실제 decision 모델이지만 채팅 LLM이 아니고 Mac/MLX에서 무용 — 메인 순위에서 제외.
